description: Tests whether the model can output a three‑token sequence in the correct order with no drift, no padding, and no reinterpretation.

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output FRAME STABILITY VECTOR with correct casing and single spaces.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add punctuation, commentary, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if output is exactly FRAME STABILITY VECTOR.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, or spacing errors.
